description:
Cast Pair o' Dice Lost by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it to add {R}.
Cast Reverberate by paying {R}{R}, targeting Pair o' Dice Lost.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creaitng a Treasure token.
Resolve Reverberate, copying Pair o' Dice Lost.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Pair o' Dice Lost, rolling a minimum result of 2 and returning at least Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
